ingredient_groups.title: Peach Filling
ingredient_groups.body:
- Fresh peaches (left unpeeled to prevent slipping while cutting) ([**0:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=8s))
- 100 g white sugar ([**3:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=192s))
- 50 g brown sugar ([**3:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=206s))
- 14 g cornstarch ([**3:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=206s))
- 100 mL water ([**3:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=206s))
- A splash of white vinegar (used as a substitute for lemon juice) ([**3:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=236s))
- 29.5 mL ground ginger ([**4:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=257s))
- 29.5 mL ground cinnamon ([**4:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=264s))
- 19.5 mL salt ([**4:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=276s))

ingredient_groups.title: Crust & Assembly
ingredient_groups.body:
- 180 g all-purpose flour ([**5:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=319s))
- 14 g baking soda ([**5:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=346s))
- 4 g salt ([**5:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=334s))
- 29.5 mL ground ginger ([**6:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=368s))
- 29.5 mL ground cinnamon ([**6:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=368s))
- 100 mL water (plus a teeny splash more if needed) ([**5:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=319s))
- 250 mL heavy whipping cream ([**6:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=416s))
- 150 mL melted butter ([**7:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=470s))

steps.title: Step 1: Prep and Cook the Peaches
steps.body:
1. Slice and core your fresh peaches, leaving the skin on for easier handling ([**1:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=61s)).
2. In a small bowl, mix together the white sugar, brown sugar, cornstarch, and 100 mL of water ([**3:00**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=180s)).
3. Pour this dry and wet sugar mixture over the peaches in a pot ([**3:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=226s)).
4. Add a splash of white vinegar, ginger, cinnamon, and 19.5 mL of salt ([**3:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=236s)).
5. Cook on the stovetop over low heat until the peaches brown slightly and a thick syrup develops ([**4:49**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=289s)). Remove from heat and set aside ([**6:40**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=400s)).

steps.title: Step 2: Make the Batter
steps.body:
1. In a mixing bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, 4 g of salt, and 29.5 mL each of ginger and cinnamon to ensure the dough is flavorful ([**5:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=319s)).
2. Pour in 100 mL of water and the heavy whipping cream ([**6:56**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=416s)).
3. Whisk everything together until it reaches a thick pancake batter consistency (add a tiny splash of water if it is too thick) ([**8:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=497s)).

steps.title: Step 3: Assemble the Cobbler
steps.body:
1. Pour 150 mL of melted butter into the bottom of your baking dish ([**7:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=470s)).
2. Pour the thick batter directly over the butter and spread it out evenly across the dish ([**8:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=497s)). *Do not mix the batter into the butter.*
3. Carefully spoon the cooked peaches and their syrup right on top of the batter, spacing the fruit out evenly ([**8:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=535s)). The crust will naturally rise up around the fruit as it bakes ([**9:07**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=547s)).

steps.title: Step 4: Bake
steps.body:
1. Bake in a preheated oven at **190 °C for 50 minutes** ([**9:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=566s)).
2. Serve warm, ideally topped with vanilla ice cream ([**9:58**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NT-0AUFGBk0&t=598s))!
